issue.title: fix: tighten negotiation price validation and audit accuracy
issue.body:
## Scope

Follow-up to #261. This PR does not change negotiation state transitions or timing. It closes smaller configuration/audit gaps found during the deep negotiation audit.

## Changes

- Require positive own-offer and accepted-counteroffer prices at the backend API boundary.
- Reject a max accepted seller counteroffer below our own offer price.
- Make frontend negotiation ladders strictly increasing in every mode, matching backend/runtime behavior.
- Record the effective attempted next-step price in real-action audits. This matters in adaptive mode where the actual prepared offer can differ from the base configured ladder.
- Add DTO regression tests.

## Safety

No catalog/category/filter behavior is touched. No scheduling cadence changes. No new real-action path is added.
